name: Centre Square
blurb: The heart of downtown, with the Soldiers' and Sailors' Monument at its center. The monument is dressed as the Peace Candle each holiday season, and the Easton Farmers' Market, running since 1752, sets up here.

name: Easton Public Market
_note: Hours from easton-pa.com. Confirm with the market before launch.
blurb: An indoor market hall of local food vendors.

name: Crayola Experience
blurb: Hands-on color and craft attractions built for kids.

name: State Theatre
blurb: Historic downtown theater hosting touring shows, concerts and comedy.

name: Sigal Museum
blurb: Regional history of Easton and Northampton County.

name: Easton Area Public Library
blurb: Main branch of the public library, with a children's room.

name: Scott Park
blurb: Riverfront park just south of the Free Bridge, where the Lehigh meets the Delaware.

name: Free Bridge
